fib: ______ is the science of application of qualitative and quantitative techniques for making inductive inference.
Statistics is the science of application of qualitative and quantitative techniques for making inductive inference.
______ are a common method to visually illustrate relationships in the data.
Graphics are a common method to visually illustrate relationships in the data.

______ is used to show the relationship between two variables and whether their values change in a consistent way, such as analyzing the relationship between the concentration levels of two different proteins.

A scattergram is used to show the relationship between two variables and whether their values change in a consistent way, such as analyzing the relationship between the concentration levels of two different proteins.

An experiment is a planned investigation that is carried out to obtain additional knowledge in order to solve identified problems and to obtain solutions to the problems.

Precision in experimentation means getting the experimental procedure right such as choice of right design make sure that there is correct randomization, replication etc . to minimize experimental error.

A journal is a periodical publication in which scholarship relating to a particular academic discipline is published.
